decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	Due to the bulk and positioning of the proposed roof extension the development has the potential to affect the character and appearance of the original dwellinghouse. The roof extension is therefore considered to be contrary to the provisions of ENV B.1.1 - New Development and H.6.4 - Extensions and Alterations of the Unitary Development Plan 2003 and Section 5.0 of the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2.	As the proposed development will harm the appearance of the original dwellinghouse, the development has the potential to create an undesirable precedent in the row of terraces which will harm the visual amenity of the Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. The proposal is thus contrary to the provisions of ENV B.1.1 - New Development and ENV B.2.2 - Conservation Areas of the Unitary Development Plan 2003 as the development will not preserve or enhance the appearance of the Conservation Area.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and rear roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
